methodChange: Remove the unsupported coupling of Default to active and Pixel to unlocked-selectable. Variant identity never supplies runtime state authority.

handoffContract.authority: The exact Design output is the sourced acceptance contract. Candidate pixels may be observed but may not create acceptance authority.
handoffContract.scope: Static visual review of named Default and Pixel captures without assigning active or selectable state from variant identity.
handoffContract.stateRule: Derive only the visible action presentation from the exact pixels: IN USE is the active presentation and USE THIS SET is the selectable presentation. A still cannot prove underlying state or interactability.
requiredSeparation: visible state presentation versus underlying runtime state and interaction behavior
agent-observable result versus explicit user acceptance
preserved capture versus exact current live runtime identity

provenanceBoundary.supported: The root created a fresh Design subagent with forkTurns none, supplied the exact v2 prompt path, and retained the final JSON verbatim.
provenanceBoundary.unverified: No App Server transport transcript, tool-event stream, model identity, or machine-enforced read allowlist was retained. This is orchestration metadata, not transport-level proof of isolation.
